title: Table 2.3a Car parking provisions for development within the Perth and Peel regions (minimum spaces per dwelling)

rows.note: Location A studio and 1 bedroom; max garage/carport (R50+) 1
Location B studio and 1 bedroom; max garage/carport (R50+) 1

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Value = minimum parking spaces per dwelling (all parking types). Ancillary dwelling row: minimum 0 in both locations, maximum garage/carport 1 at R50+ (rules C2.3.1-r1, -r3). Maximum garage and carport column (R50 and above only; footnote 1: none at R40 and below) is in rule C2.3.1-r2: 1 for studio/1 bed, 2 for 2 bed and 3+ bed. LOCATION A: all land within 800 m of a train station on a high-frequency rail route (straight line from the pedestrian entry to the platform to any part of the lot); within 250 m of a high-frequency transit route, or multiple routes that combined have timed stops every 15 minutes in weekday peaks 7-9am and 5-7pm (straight line from any part of the route to any part of the lot); and/or within the defined boundaries of an activity centre. LOCATION B: all other land. Register ch2-023: straight-line measurement replaces 'walkable catchment', enlarging Location A; 'high-frequency' is not defined.
